_source: CORE Math Pacing Guide Grade K - Zearn, uploaded by Loren 8/29/26, transcribed by week from the per-week lesson lists (not just the header row). Same pattern as Grade 5 week 28, Grade 7 weeks 33/34, Grade 8 week 29. Two other guide slips noticed but not schema-relevant: weeks 11 and 36 attach 2nd-grade standards codes (2.OA.1 etc.) to Kindergarten shape lessons, and weeks 15/17 link 'Mission 4 Teacher and Student Materials' while still inside Mission 3 - both are standards/materials-link errors in the guide itself, outside the mission/lessons/topic/assessment schema this file carries. Verified against Appendix A's Grade K Zearn row at deficit=0 across all 10 LPs using week_shift.py's shifted_windows and zearn_content: lesson ranges and mission boundaries match Appendix A exactly on all 10 LPs (LP1 Mission 1 Lessons 1-17 + Mid-Mission Assessment; LP2 Mission 1 Lessons 18-37; LP3 Mission 2 Lessons 1-10 + End-of-Mission Assessment, Mission 3 Lessons 1-5; LP4 Mission 3 Lessons 6-17 + Mid-Mission Assessment; LP5 Mission 3 Lessons 18-32, Mission 4 Lessons 1-2; LP6 Mission 4 Lessons 3-22; LP7 Mission 4 Lessons 23-39 + Mid-Mission Assessment; LP8 Mission 4 Lessons 40-41 + End-of-Mission Assessment, Mission 5 Lessons 1-10; LP9 Mission 5 Lessons 11-24 + Mid- and End-of-Mission Assessments; LP10 Mission 6 Lessons 1-8 + End-of-Mission Assessment). Only assessment wording differs from Appendix A's generic phrasing, which is the expected, documented Zearn shape and not a defect. No window-vs-prose divergence and no assessment-only mission tail anywhere in the year - first grade with a clean match on all 10 LPs since Grade 8.
